## function for exporting tables

```{r}

export_df_to_latex <- function(df, file_path, caption = NULL) {
  
  #-----------------------------
  # Helper: escape LaTeX specials
  #-----------------------------
  escape_latex <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\textbackslash{}", x)
    x <- gsub("([%&_#\\$])", "\\\\\\1", x)
    x <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", x)
    return(x)
  }
  
  # Convert to character
  df[] <- lapply(df, as.character)
  
  # Escape LaTeX characters
  df[] <- lapply(df, escape_latex)
  colnames(df) <- escape_latex(colnames(df))
  
  # Alignment: first left, rest right
  n_cols <- ncol(df)
  align_string <- paste0("l", paste(rep("r", n_cols - 1), collapse = ""))
  
  # Build body rows
  body_rows <- apply(df, 1, function(row) {
    paste(row, collapse = " & ")
  })
  
  body_rows <- paste0(body_rows, " \\\\")
  body_text <- paste(body_rows, collapse = "\n")
  
  # Header row
  header <- paste(colnames(df), collapse = " & ")
  header <- paste0(header, " \\\\")
  
  # Caption + label handling
  file_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_path))
  
  if (is.null(caption)) {
    caption_text <- gsub("_", " ", file_name)
  } else {
    caption_text <- caption
  }
  
  label <- paste0("tab:", file_name)
  
  # Build LaTeX table
  latex_table <- paste0(
"\\begin{table}[t]
\\centering
\\fontsize{12pt}{14pt}\\selectfont
\\begin{tabular}{@{\\extracolsep{\\fill}}", align_string, "}
\\toprule
", header, "
\\midrule\\addlinespace[2.5pt]
", body_text, "
\\bottomrule
\\end{tabular}
\\caption{", caption_text, "}
\\label{", label, "}
\\end{table}"
  )
  
  # Write file
  writeLines(latex_table, file_path)
  
  message("LaTeX table exported to: ", file_path)
}



```




## plot acreaage and policies for RI and VI

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(scales)

#---------------------------
# Build dataset
#---------------------------
plan_enrollment <- lapply(2007:2025, function(year){

  print(year)

  # Column names
  data_w_names <- read.csv(here("data/PRF_sob/sobcov_2024_names.csv"))
  column_names <- colnames(data_w_names)

  year_2 <- substr(as.character(year), 3, 4)

  data <- read.csv(
    here(paste0("data/PRF_sob/raw_files/sobcov", year_2, ".txt")),
    sep = "|"
  )

  names(data) <- column_names

  # Filter PRF + plans
  data_prf <- data %>%
    filter(
      Commodity.Code == 88,
      Insurance.Plan.Code %in% c(13, 14)
    )

  # Summarize nationally
  plan_sums <- data_prf %>%
    group_by(Insurance.Plan.Code) %>%
    summarise(
      Policies = sum(Policies.Sold.Count, na.rm = TRUE),
      Acres    = sum(Net.Reported.Quantity, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups  = "drop"
    )

  plan_sums$year <- year

  return(plan_sums)

}) %>% do.call("rbind", .)

#---------------------------
# Format variables
#---------------------------
plan_enrollment <- plan_enrollment %>%
  mutate(
    Plan = case_when(
      Insurance.Plan.Code == 13 ~ "Rainfall Index",
      Insurance.Plan.Code == 14 ~ "Vegetation Index"
    ),
    year = as.Date(paste0(year, "-01-01"))
  )

#---------------------------
# Plot 1 — Policies
#---------------------------
p_policies <- ggplot(plan_enrollment,
                     aes(x = year,
                         y = Policies,
                         color = Plan)) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +

  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Rainfall Index"   = "steelblue",
    "Vegetation Index" = "darkgreen"
  )) +

  scale_x_date(
    breaks = seq(min(plan_enrollment$year),
                 max(plan_enrollment$year),
                 by = "2 years"),
    date_labels = "%Y"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "PRF Policies by Index Type",
    x = "Data Source: USDA State-County-Crop Summary of Business",
    y = "Policies",
    color = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

#---------------------------
# Plot 2 — Acres
#---------------------------
p_acres <- ggplot(plan_enrollment,
                  aes(x = year,
                      y = Acres,
                      color = Plan)) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +

  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Rainfall Index"   = "steelblue",
    "Vegetation Index" = "darkgreen"
  )) +

  scale_x_date(
    breaks = seq(min(plan_enrollment$year),
                 max(plan_enrollment$year),
                 by = "2 years"),
    date_labels = "%Y"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "PRF Insured Acres by Index Type",
    x = "Data Source: USDA State-County-Crop Summary of Business",
    y = "Acres",
    color = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

#---------------------------
# Show plots
#---------------------------
p_policies
p_acres



```

```{r}
plan_percent <- plan_enrollment %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    policy_share = Policies / sum(Policies),
    acre_share   = Acres    / sum(Acres)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

```

## total acres % (all years)

```{r}
total_ri_acres <- plan_enrollment %>% filter(Plan == "Rainfall Index") %>% pull(Acres) %>% sum()

total_vi_acres <- plan_enrollment %>% filter(Plan == "Vegetation Index") %>% pull(Acres) %>% sum()

pct_vi <- 100*(total_vi_acres)/(total_ri_acres + total_vi_acres)

```
